metadata.name: 3D Model Quality Schema
metadata.description: Quality gate schema for 3D model assets. Requires polygon budget, coordinate system and unit metadata, and proves every model converts through the built-in 3D conversion pipeline before it is approved for use.

description: Quality requirements for 3D model assets: polygon count, coordinate system and unit metadata, plus a successful GLB conversion of the model file. The conversion rule selects source formats only and leaves out *.glb: the conversion pipeline writes its .glb output back into the asset, and selecting it would make the asset's own output a second conversion candidate.

checks.name: geometry-fields-present
checks.description: The default asset metadata schema's required fields are present and typed as declared, and the model documents its polygon count, coordinate reference system and unit of measurement.

checks.name: conversion-succeeds
checks.description: The model file converts to GLB. The pipeline writes no compliance-output document, so the check reads the execution's own success measurement.

checks.name: conversion-duration
checks.description: The conversion completes within ten minutes.
